Reverser_F.note: Accepted 1 (Forward) at once after DriversBrakeCutOut_F = 0; assumed symmetric to Reverser_B, which swept 0 / 0.5 / 1.

MasterController_F.note: Re-swept by Fable 2026-10-11 15:00 with DriversBrakeCutOut_F set to 0 (Cut-In) and Reverser_F Forward: both sides continuous and linear as the BR 147 (output = (|input|-0.1)/0.9 signed). Locked at 0.1 before because the service starts with the valve cut out.

AFB_Speed_F.note: Re-swept by Fable 2026-10-11 with the valve cut in: 0.15 = 15, 0.5 = 90, 0.75 = 145, 1 = 200 km/h in 5 km/h steps; no Off notch (AFB_ProxySwitchControl and AFB_Confirm_Speed_F push buttons do on/off and confirm).

interlocks: A timetable service starts with DriversBrakeCutOut_F at 1 (Cut-Out) and PZB_Isolation / Sifa_Isolation / LZB_Isolation at 0 (Isolated); with the valve cut out Reverser_F ignores sets and MasterController_F stores nothing above 0.1. Setting DriversBrakeCutOut_F to 0 frees both at once (no key cycle needed; MasterKey_F was already 1).
